    Install¶

    rn_forge.tooling.install ¶

    Release sources, workstation installation, and lifecycle operations.

    Check = Callable[[ToolHome], Iterable[Finding]] module-attribute ¶

    A product-specific doctor check: inspect the install, report what is true of it.

    Report a passing check as an info finding rather than nothing, so doctor shows that it ran.

    If the subclass was not decorated with @dataclasses.dataclass.

    from_dict(data) classmethod ¶

    Create an instance from a dict, recursively rebuilding nested dataclasses.

    Only keys that match declared dataclass field names are passed to the constructor. This makes from_dict tolerant of extra data (e.g. when loading from a config file that has fields added in a newer schema version). Nested dataclass-typed fields are reconstructed recursively for common container annotations, via :mod:dacite.

    Note a nested dataclass field's own overridden from_dict (if any) is not called — dacite structures nested dataclasses itself.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    data dict[str, Any]

    A dict whose keys correspond to dataclass field names. Unrecognised keys are silently ignored, or rejected when the class's __dacite_config__ sets strict.

    		 required

    Returns:

    Type Description
    Self

    A new instance of this class populated with matching field values.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    A value does not match its field's declared type, a required field is absent, or an enum-typed field names a member the enum does not define. Under strict, also a key that names no field, at any nesting level; the message lists every such key by its dotted path (repository.archtype).
    TypeError

    If the subclass was not decorated with @dataclasses.dataclass.

    GitHubReleases(repo, tag_prefix='v', api_url='https://api.github.com', web_url='https://github.com') dataclass ¶

    Releases published as tags of a GitHub repository.

    The archive is GitHub's generated source tarball for the tag. GitHub publishes no checksum for those, so :meth:checksum returns None and the download is trusted to TLS; a product that attaches a checksum asset to its releases implements :class:ReleaseSource to verify it.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    repo str

    owner/name.

    		 required
    tag_prefix str

    What the tag carries before the version — "v" for v1.2.0, "golden-tool-v" in a monorepo.

    		 'v'
    api_url str

    The GitHub API root, for GitHub Enterprise.

    		 'https://api.github.com'
    web_url str

    The GitHub web root the tarball is served from.

    		 'https://github.com'

    checksum(version) ¶

    None: GitHub publishes no checksum for a generated tarball.

    download(version, destination) ¶

    Download the tag's source tarball into destination.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    The download failed.

    latest() ¶

    Return the version of the repository's latest release.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    The request failed, or the latest release's tag does not carry :attr:tag_prefix.

    Link(path, target) dataclass ¶

    A symlink an install puts in place outside the version directory.

    The link points through current, never at a version directory, so an upgrade swaps what it resolves to without touching the link.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    path str

    Where the link goes, relative to $RNF_HOME — bin/golden-tool.

    		 required
    target str

    What it points at, relative to the installed version's root.

    		 required

    LocalArchive(path, version, sha256=None) dataclass ¶

    One archive already on disk, standing in for a release.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    path Path

    The archive file.

    		 required
    version str

    The version the archive holds. Not inferred from its contents: reading a version out of a tree is the product's convention, not this module's.

    		 required
    sha256 str | None

    The digest to verify against, when known.

    		 None

    checksum(version) ¶

    The digest given at construction, if any.

    download(version, destination) ¶

    Copy the archive into destination.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    version is not the archive's, or the file is missing.

    latest() ¶

    The archive's own version — it is the only one there is.

    ReleaseSource ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Where a product's releases are published.

    checksum(version) ¶

    Return the SHA-256 hex digest version's archive must match, if published.

    download(version, destination) ¶

    Write the archive for version into the directory destination.

    Returns:

    Type Description
    Path

    The archive file.

    latest() ¶

    Return the newest released version.

    ToolHome(name, root=None) ¶

    The on-disk layout of one product under $RNF_HOME.

    Initialize :class:ToolHome.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    name str

    The product name; its directory under root.

    		 required
    root str | Path | None

    The home directory. Defaults to :func:rnf_home, resolved now rather than per access, so one instance never straddles a change to the environment.

    		 None

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    name is not a single path segment.

    current property ¶

    The current symlink. May not exist.

    product_dir property ¶

    <home>/<product>/.

    state_path property ¶

    <home>/<product>/state.json.

    versions_dir property ¶

    <home>/<product>/versions/.

    work_dir property ¶

    Scratch space for a transaction in flight; removed when it finishes.

    activate(version) ¶

    Point current at version, atomically.

    The link is relative (versions/<version>), so moving the whole home does not break it.

    current_version() ¶

    The version current points at, or None when there is no link.

    installed_versions() ¶

    Every version directory present, in name order.

    lock(*, timeout=30.0) ¶

    The lock every lifecycle verb that writes holds for its whole duration.

    version_dir(version) ¶

    <home>/<product>/versions/<version>/.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    version is not a single path segment — a release source is remote input, and ../.. is a version string too.

    GitHubReleases(repo, tag_prefix='v', api_url='https://api.github.com', web_url='https://github.com') dataclass ¶

    Releases published as tags of a GitHub repository.

    The archive is GitHub's generated source tarball for the tag. GitHub publishes no checksum for those, so :meth:checksum returns None and the download is trusted to TLS; a product that attaches a checksum asset to its releases implements :class:ReleaseSource to verify it.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default

    		 'v'
    api_url str

    The GitHub API root, for GitHub Enterprise.

    		 'https://api.github.com'
    web_url str

    The GitHub web root the tarball is served from.

    		 'https://github.com'

    checksum(version) ¶

    None: GitHub publishes no checksum for a generated tarball.

    doctor(product, *, home=None) ¶

    Inspect the install, then run the product's own checks.

    A product that is not installed is a warning, not an error: the same command runs from a development checkout, where there is nothing under $RNF_HOME and nothing wrong. The product's checks run either way.

    Returns:

    Type Description
    list[Finding]

    Every finding, product checks last. Only an error should fail the
    list[Finding]

    command.

    status(product, *, home=None) ¶

    Report the running version and what is installed. Writes nothing.

    uninstall(product, *, home=None) ¶

    Remove the product's links and its whole directory under the home.

    Works over an install that never completed: nothing here assumes current or state.json exists. A link is removed only when it still points where this product put it — a path someone has since replaced with their own file or link is left alone.
